evidence.ACL: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
evidence.Medial Meniscus: Degenerative oblique tear of the posterior horn.
evidence.Lateral Meniscus: Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
evidence.Medial OA: Medial compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning.
evidence.Lateral OA: Lateral compartment cartilage: Mild cartilage thinning.
evidence.PF OA: Mild cartilage fissuring along the lateral patellar facet and central femoral trochlea.
evidence.Contusion: Bone marrow edema in the lateral aspect of the proximal tibia suggestive of bone bruise in appropriate clinical setting.
evidence.Fracture: Alignment is anatomic. There is patchy bone marrow edema in the lateral aspect of the proximal tibia, may represent bone bruise in appropriate clinical setting. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.
